description: This is a unit test class for the RetrieveThingLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl in the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.commands.live.query package. It tests various scenarios of building answers for live commands related to retrieving things, including responses with Thing data and error responses.

classes.name: RetrieveThingLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImplTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for RetrieveThingLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl, testing answer building logic for retrieve commands including success and error scenarios.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the mock behavior and initializes the object under test before each test case.

methods.name: tryToGetNewInstanceWithNullCommand
methods.description: Verifies that creating a new instance with null command throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: buildAnswerWithoutResponse
methods.description: Tests building a live command answer without any response.

methods.name: buildAnswerWithRetrieveThingResponseOnly
methods.description: Tests building a live command answer that contains only a successful retrieve thing response.

methods.name: buildAnswerWithThingNotAccessibleErrorResponseOnly
methods.description: Tests building a live command answer that contains only a 'thing not accessible' error response.
